newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, TRADED VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Stock turnover and traded volume rose at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE), the MSE said.
Total turnover grew to 266,409 denars from 160,218 denars at the last session on August 15 and traded volume rose to 143 shares from 86.
Gradski Targovski Centar sold 143 stocks on the first floor at 1,863 denars, unchanged from last trading and below par of 2,661 denars.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=39.37 denars; 1DEM=26.61 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 84561
